issues.detail: #32 was rejected before compute because the workflow did not declare the credential required by its private upload. Upstream disposition: Recipe integration fix; no upstream model defect asserted.
issues.fix: Declare HF_TOKEN in workflow secrets and preflight input access.
issues.title: Missing declared upload credential

issues.detail: #33 ended without acquiring an instance or running a task; finalized compute cost was $0.00. Upstream disposition: Compute routing issue; no upstream model change.
issues.fix: Continue on an existing compatible 96 GB Blackwell target.
issues.title: No allocation on the initial compute route

issues.detail: #34 first failed dependency resolution across PyPI and the CUDA wheel index. Upstream disposition: Potential upstream environment documentation improvement; no upstream PR recorded.
issues.fix: Use the aligned CUDA 12.8 dependency pins and explicit uv index strategy in the pinned setup recipe.
issues.title: Cold dependency resolution and Blackwell compatibility

issues.detail: #34 next failed duplicated Accelerate/DeepSpeed precision settings, then failed batch-size inference because the custom DataLoader exposed no batch_size. Upstream disposition: Recipe integration fixes; retained regression coverage.
issues.fix: Keep BF16 in the DeepSpeed JSON and explicitly set micro/global batch size 4 with accumulation 1.
issues.title: Precision ownership and custom-sampler batch inference

issues.detail: #35 hit confirmed host OOM during optimizer preparation. Moving optimizer state to GPU exposed the demo input mismatch. A further candidate was rejected before launch because it expected action width 29 and lacked two history observations. Upstream disposition: Exception handling is a potential upstream fix. Demo adaptation is canary-specific and has not established policy semantics.
issues.fix: Disable CPU optimizer offload; use the pinned 58/138/2/32 contract and an explicit shape-only demo adapter. Initialize the exception-path output variable so the original failure is preserved.
issues.title: Host OOM followed by demo/checkpoint mismatch

issues.detail: Earlier retries required a harness staging-ownership checkpoint correction and maintainer recovery. Idle failed-job instances were manually stopped. Those attempts are not unattended successes. Upstream disposition: Harness fix 12105c06493f949873f84caf3dcd53713037340b; no upstream model change.
issues.fix: Preserve the same owned private destination during retry and retain append-only intervention records; continue under the remaining original budget.
issues.title: Retry ownership checkpoint and manual recovery

issues.detail: #36 completed training and upload, but publication contained only 3 jobs / 57 artifacts / 120 links versus the captured 5 / 71 / 212. Traversal selected only the latest producer of byte-identical copied content. Upstream disposition: Roar PR #302 was merged. The incomplete historical publication was retained as blocked.
issues.fix: Install Roar main at 61e5e98ca823a25c19522870cb81d3ce730c391d, including the merged multiple-producer traversal fix; verify a fresh run.
issues.title: Published lineage omitted train and evaluate

issues.detail: #37 completed the workload and full lineage publication. Readback was delayed by a network outage, then failed because two evaluation paths were redacted in logs but remained absolute in the uploaded result. An uncaught verification error caused worker restarts. Upstream disposition: Model recipe and harness fixes; prior result preserved. Maintainer intervention prevents an unattended-success claim for #37.
issues.fix: Use repository-relative evaluation paths (recipe 3308fc9) and retain invalid artifacts as BLOCKED (harness 7be12d4). Run #38 afresh after both fixes.
issues.title: Portable receipts and bounded verification failure

issues.detail: #38 labels the training wrapper as other and packaging as training; the latest producer field identifies packaging. An additional directed producer edge identifies the actual training command. Upstream disposition: Platform follow-up; no role-label fix is claimed.
issues.fix: The independent auditor checked commands and directed edges, not the role heuristic alone. Role labeling remains a follow-up.
issues.title: Lineage role labels remain imprecise

issues.detail: Roar reported untracked artifact directories during the final publication path. Upstream disposition: Capture/filtering follow-up; no fix is claimed.
issues.fix: Retain the warning and bound the result to the independently checked published inventory and lineage. No warning-free capture claim.
issues.title: Untracked-directory warning remains
